study.title: Recognizing Zucchinis Intercropped with Sunflowers in UAV Visible Images Using an Improved Method Based on OCRNet
study.short_title: Recognizing Zucchinis Intercropped with Sunflowers in UAV Visible Images Using an Improved OCRNet

segmentation.best_model: Improved OCRNet (SE_MIX_OCRNet) with channel attention + mixed loss

dataset.name: UAV visible images of zucchini/sunflower intercropping, Hetao Irrigation District, Inner Mongolia, China
dataset.note: DJI S900 + RedEdge multispectral camera (visible RGB used); flown 11:00-13:00, 88% heading / 84% side overlap; 256x256 crops with 75% overlap; 27,130 training / 16,800 test tiles; test areas imaged 26-Jul-2020 (TA1) and 02-Aug-2020 (TA2).

mIoU.quote: The mIoU and intercropping IoU of our proposed method in test area 1 reached 94.44% and 96.57%, respectively, and the mIoU and Intercropping IoU in test area 2 reached 95.05% and 94.51%, respectively.
mIoU.ambiguity: Best proposed-method result on test area 2 (95.05%); test area 1 mIoU 94.44%.

mPA.quote: Among these evaluation metrics, our proposed method performed best, reaching 94.44%, 96.78%, 0.9534, and 96.57%, respectively.
mPA.ambiguity: Mean accuracy (mAcc) 96.78% on test area 1 for the proposed method; TA2 mAcc (96.89%, derived) slightly lower than DeepLabV3+.

PA.ambiguity: Intercropping class accuracy (Acc) 99.59% (TA1) / 96.19% (TA2) reported as class-level accuracy, not global pixel accuracy.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-crop IoU reported via classes; done here via pixel metrics instead.
